118f8da1-3f01-4205-96cd-10c3160d812f.sentence: When a start request names its user or its group with a JSON string, the agentd shall resolve the name against the guest's /etc/passwd or /etc/group before it spawns the child.
118f8da1-3f01-4205-96cd-10c3160d812f.systemResponse: resolve the name against the guest's /etc/passwd or /etc/group before it spawns the child
118f8da1-3f01-4205-96cd-10c3160d812f.trigger: a start request names its user or its group with a JSON string

17ee4127-2c73-4196-9e08-2c6b50b49893.sentence: When a bootstrap request presents a token equal to the installed agent token, the agentd shall accept the bootstrap request.
17ee4127-2c73-4196-9e08-2c6b50b49893.trigger: a bootstrap request presents a token equal to the installed agent token

2567e204-d35f-41aa-befa-ff52a4e4910d.sentence: If a start request names a user or a group that the guest's /etc/passwd or /etc/group does not contain, then the agentd shall answer Bad Request with the unknown_user or unknown_group error naming the value and spawn no child.
2567e204-d35f-41aa-befa-ff52a4e4910d.systemResponse: answer Bad Request with the unknown_user or unknown_group error naming the value and spawn no child
2567e204-d35f-41aa-befa-ff52a4e4910d.trigger: a start request names a user or a group that the guest's /etc/passwd or /etc/group does not contain

3d30678f-09e2-4bbb-99de-55e0e34a8ba3.sentence: When a start request names a shell, the agentd shall resolve the shell name on the child PATH, the image PATH, /bin and /usr/bin and run the command as the -c script of the resolved shell.
3d30678f-09e2-4bbb-99de-55e0e34a8ba3.systemResponse: resolve the shell name on the child PATH, the image PATH, /bin and /usr/bin and run the command as the -c script of the resolved shell
3d30678f-09e2-4bbb-99de-55e0e34a8ba3.trigger: a start request names a shell

52611cba-ebc5-4e49-836c-b50fcf4227cf.sentence: The agentd shall report on /v1/health whether an image environment snapshot exists and its key count, without its values.
52611cba-ebc5-4e49-836c-b50fcf4227cf.systemResponse: report on /v1/health whether an image environment snapshot exists and its key count, without its values

53d804ed-90e3-4b63-af15-cdc66952c306.sentence: When a start request sets inherit_image_env, the agentd shall place the environment the agentd inherited at startup beneath the passwd identity, the launch environment and the request environment.
53d804ed-90e3-4b63-af15-cdc66952c306.systemResponse: place the environment the agentd inherited at startup beneath the passwd identity, the launch environment and the request environment

5a4396e5-82e3-49b0-8228-5084c21a02b8.sentence: When the user of a start request resolves to a passwd row, the agentd shall set HOME, USER and LOGNAME from the passwd row beneath the launch environment and the request environment.
5a4396e5-82e3-49b0-8228-5084c21a02b8.systemResponse: set HOME, USER and LOGNAME from the passwd row beneath the launch environment and the request environment
5a4396e5-82e3-49b0-8228-5084c21a02b8.trigger: the user of a start request resolves to a passwd row

5d566fcc-5e88-4170-87d7-34047919f664.sentence: If a start request names a shell that no searched directory holds as an executable file, then the agentd shall answer Bad Request with the unknown_shell error naming the shell and spawn no child.
5d566fcc-5e88-4170-87d7-34047919f664.systemResponse: answer Bad Request with the unknown_shell error naming the shell and spawn no child
5d566fcc-5e88-4170-87d7-34047919f664.trigger: a start request names a shell that no searched directory holds as an executable file

64c3f6b9-b3e1-459f-95db-969638de56e6.sentence: When a control request presents a token equal to the installed agent token, the agentd shall accept the control request.
64c3f6b9-b3e1-459f-95db-969638de56e6.trigger: a control request presents a token equal to the installed agent token

692cc585-d872-4e9e-bd14-ec068780d90c.preCondition: the agent token is not installed
692cc585-d872-4e9e-bd14-ec068780d90c.sentence: While the agent token is not installed, the agentd shall reject the control request.

6c8fafac-7f77-4b1d-ab08-0f0668160fde.sentence: When a bootstrap request presents a token that differs from the installed agent token, the agentd shall reject the bootstrap request.

70eed926-78da-4b53-8f5c-13d4a575f520.sentence: When a bootstrap request presents a token and the agent token is not installed, the agentd shall install the agent token.
70eed926-78da-4b53-8f5c-13d4a575f520.trigger: a bootstrap request presents a token and the agent token is not installed

d4f15798-c44b-426e-a642-d268ee4018e8.sentence: The agentd shall exclude each AGENTD_ variable and the agent token from the image environment snapshot.

d8f5ac1b-42e0-44bc-aa05-6eb2a0586847.sentence: When a control request presents a token that differs from the installed agent token, the agentd shall reject the control request.

e0ee62fc-08dc-4abe-b16e-7aa956da32e2.sentence: When a start request carries its user and group as integers and its shell as a boolean, the agentd shall demote the child to exactly those ids and run a true shell as /bin/sh -c.
e0ee62fc-08dc-4abe-b16e-7aa956da32e2.systemResponse: demote the child to exactly those ids and run a true shell as /bin/sh -c
e0ee62fc-08dc-4abe-b16e-7aa956da32e2.trigger: a start request carries its user and group as integers and its shell as a boolean

f7d0a588-6b31-4b49-8f4c-eaa0c7afc334.preCondition: a start request leaves inherit_image_env unset
f7d0a588-6b31-4b49-8f4c-eaa0c7afc334.sentence: While a start request leaves inherit_image_env unset, the agentd shall build the child environment from the passwd identity, the launch environment and the request environment only.
f7d0a588-6b31-4b49-8f4c-eaa0c7afc334.systemResponse: build the child environment from the passwd identity, the launch environment and the request environment only
